The UNICEF/Trudell 2017 country review for Madagascar sets out the language policy, the education policy and the studies feeding the Education Sector Plan 2018-2022, and the only language-policy activity it names is a national seminar on language policy in education organised by the French embassy; it names no programme, body, start date or funding for reversing shift in Malagasy or its varieties. The UNESCO PEER Madagascar inclusion profile describes only the sector plan's reading, mother-tongue transition and plurilingual aims, and records that provision is made for adopting a new language policy.
